fixes.explanation: Repeat sounds close, but it isn't Moses' word. He says, “Be sure to remember what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and all Egypt…” What did the LORD do? The great trials, the signs and wonders, and the mighty hand and outstretched arm (Deuteronomy 7:19). Israel isn't asked to repeat any of that. They're asked to keep it in mind, so the fear has nowhere to sit.

problems.problem: The explanation treats “repeat” as saying something again, but the answer refers to repeating what the LORD did. It should distinguish remembering His actions from repeating them.
